literal_meaning: চোখের তীক্ষ্ণ দৃষ্টির অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ (onomatopoeic sound of alert peering)
figurative_meaning_en: To stay alert; to be on vigilant lookout
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তক্কেতক্কে চারপাশ দেখছে যাতে কেউ না আসে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is looking around alertly to ensure no one approaches.
The police are scanning the area vigilantly.
note: This idiom mimics the sound of quick, cautious glances, common in colloquial Bengali for expressing wariness.
